Definition: to admit, i.e. take (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: To receive runs through very different scenes: the Jews undertook to keep the days of Purim as Mordecai had written, Job asked whether we shall receive good at the hand of God and not receive evil, and Proverbs tells the young to receive instruction.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the pattern as one lesson: receiving is not passive, it is the decision to take what God hands us, good or hard, and live by it.
